subject.title: feat: play ordered track URI lists

question: Should `spogo play` permanently accept multiple track arguments and expose `PlayTracks` across every engine, with Connect delegating this mode to the Web API?
rationale: This adds a new CLI grammar and engine API/fallback contract; tests can validate mechanics, but maintainer intent must establish whether it is the desired long-term product surface.

options.title: Accept variadic playback
options.body: Keep multi-track `play`, requiring correct name-or-ID device resolution, compatibility tests, and live Spotify proof before merge.

options.title: Limit the surface
options.body: Expose ordered playback only through a narrower Web-engine command or API without expanding every engine contract.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Keep `play` single-item and direct multi-track workflows to playlists or queue operations.

recommendation.title: Accept variadic playback
recommendation.body: Keep multi-track `play`, requiring correct name-or-ID device resolution, compatibility tests, and live Spotify proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing candidate for the existing CLI and playback-engine product contract.
